overview: When your store has a real problem, you want a person who already knows your setup. We set up a direct support channel, record your key accounts and settings in a handover note and agree response targets in writing. During your order window, urgent issues go to the front of our queue, and we fix what we can in your own store and tell you straight away what needs your host or platform. Longer term support is quoted separately.

faq: Is this support available every hour of the day?
No. Response targets apply on business days and are written into your agreement. We do not promise round the clock cover. Anything outside those hours is answered when the next window opens.
What counts as an urgent problem?
Anything that blocks sales or damages the store, such as a broken checkout, a missing page, a stuck payment or a theme that stops loading. We confirm what counts when we start.
What if the fault is with my host or platform?
We find the cause, collect the evidence and help you raise it with the right support team. We cannot repair servers that we do not control, but we can speed the process.
What happens after the order window?
You get a plan for ongoing support and a quote that suits your store. Without a continuing plan, we simply return to normal order-based work.
